properties.accesses_personal_information_why: Sign-in creates a Tortuga account (the sign-in provider's ID for the user, a verified email when it shares one). Crash reports (sent when the app crashes or a fault stops one part of it), on by default and off in Settings > This device > Privacy, carry the error and the device's model and system, no account or device ID; the privacy policy describes both.

age_rating.certificate: IARC: enter the rating ID from Play's IARC certificate, or answer as google-play/forms.json content_rating_iarc and the follow-ups below
age_rating.shared_user_generated_content_primary_wh: A video player: what people share is Watch together's room state (a profile's name and what plays), around playback.
age_rating.public_why: The app has no content of its own: catalogs and streams come from addons the user installs, and the demo addon links public-domain and Blender films.
age_rating.users_can_block_why: Content: a kids profile shows titles up to the age a parent sets and hides the titles the parent blocks. People: no block list; in Watch together the host can remove a person from the room and lock it to new people.
age_rating.chat_why: No chat: Watch together carries no messages, voice or images, only the room's playback and each person's profile name.
age_rating.interactions_why: A Watch together room is joined only with its 6-character code or invite link, which the host passes on; there is no list or search of rooms, and the host can lock the room.

notes_for_certification: On the sign-in screen, choose Link from another device: the app shows a code. In any browser, open https://api.usetortuga.app/review, enter the review password {reviewer_password} and the code, and choose Sign in the device. The app signs in to the review account within a few seconds. Nothing plays until an addon with streams is installed. To see something play, open Settings, then Addons, choose Install addon, enter https://usetortuga.app/demo/manifest.json, then Continue and Install. On Home, the last row is Tortuga demo: open Tears of Steel, choose Play and pick the Tortuga demo stream (it plays from download.blender.org); Night of the Living Dead (1968) plays from the Internet Archive. Support: support@usetortuga.app.
